result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is prematurely clipped mid-character despite having ample available space.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is abruptly clipped mid-character ('Tokumaru Rameı') without an ellipsis, despite plenty of empty horizontal space remaining before the rating badge.
issues.suggestion: Allow the restaurant title container to expand into the available flex/grid space up to the rating element, and apply `text-overflow: ellipsis` if truncation is genuinely needed for very long names.
